row.정의: 자원, 행동, 도구 집합, 응답의 4개 차원에 걸친 12개 제약 범주를 기반으로 만든 도구 사용 벤치마크. 200개 테스트 케이스로 구성되며 케이스당 평균 7개 제약 유형을 포함하고 평균 프롬프트 길이는 4,754토큰(Qwen3 토크나이저 기준, 도구 설명 포함). 실행 가능한 제약 검증 모듈이 멀티턴 상호작용의 매 단계에서 준수 여부를 검사하고 위반 시 피드백을 준다. 지표는 SR(모든 하위 질의 해결 및 제약 충족, 위반 후 수정 허용)과 PSR(위반 없이 모든 하위 질의 해결)이다. 논문은 9개 LLM을 사고/비사고 모드에서 3회 반복 평가했다.
row.대표 과제: 제약을 지키며 도구를 호출해 질의를 해결하는 멀티턴 과제. single-hop, parallel single-hop, multi-hop, parallel multi-hop 4개 범주(각 50개)
row.대표 예시·설명: 시스템 프롬프트에 상호작용 라운드 상한, 특정 도구 호출 횟수 제한, 도구 호출 순서 의존성, 최종 응답 형식 같은 제약이 주어진다. 모델은 로컬 실행 도구를 호출해 질문에 답하고, 위반하면 검증 모듈의 피드백을 받아 수정한다(과제 설명).
row.이용 시 유의사항: 데이터와 코드 라이선스를 확인하지 못했다. 케이스는 FTRL 데이터셋(Ye et al., 2025b)에서 파생되었으므로 원본 약관도 별도로 확인해야 한다. 규모가 200케이스로 작고 단일 출처에서 만들어졌다. 제약 검증 코드는 LLM이 생성한 뒤 사람이 검수했다. 평가에는 각 모델의 API와 로컬 도구 실행 환경이 필요하다.

english_copy.definition: A tool-use benchmark built on 12 constraint categories across four dimensions: resource, behavior, toolset, and response. It has 200 test cases, each with an average of seven constraint types and an average prompt length of 4,754 tokens (Qwen3 tokenizer, including tool descriptions). An executable validation module checks compliance at every step of multi-turn interaction and returns feedback on violations. Metrics are SR (all subqueries solved with all constraints satisfied, violations may be corrected) and PSR (all subqueries solved with no violations). The paper evaluates nine LLMs in thinking and non-thinking modes over three runs.
english_copy.task: Multi-turn tool-use tasks solved under explicit constraints, in four categories of 50 cases each: single-hop, parallel single-hop, multi-hop, and parallel multi-hop
english_copy.example: Task description: the system prompt sets constraints such as a limit on interaction rounds, a cap on calls to specific tools, an ordering dependency between tools, and a required final-answer format. The model calls locally executable tools to answer a question and revises its behavior after receiving violation feedback.

screening.paper_title: CCTU: A Benchmark for Tool Use under Complex Constraints
screening.abstract: Solving problems through tool use under explicit constraints constitutes a highly challenging yet unavoidable scenario for large language models (LLMs), requiring capabilities such as function calling, instruction following, and self-refinement. However, progress has been hindered by the absence of dedicated evaluations. To address this, we introduce CCTU, a benchmark for evaluating LLM tool use under complex constraints. CCTU is grounded in a taxonomy of 12 constraint categories spanning four dimensions (i.e., resource, behavior, toolset, and response). The benchmark comprises 200 carefully curated and challenging test cases across diverse tool-use scenarios, each involving an average of seven constraint types and an average prompt length exceeding 4,700 tokens. To enable reliable evaluation, we develop an executable constraint validation module that performs step-level validation and enforces compliance during multi-turn interactions between models and their environments. We evaluate nine state-of-the-art LLMs in both thinking and non-thinking modes. Results indicate that when strict adherence to all constraints is required, no model achieves a task completion rate above 20\%. Further analysis reveals that models violate constraints in over 50\% of cases, particularly in the resource and response dimensions. Moreover, LLMs demonstrate limited capacity for self-refinement even after receiving detailed feedback on constraint violations, highlighting a critical bottleneck in the development of robust tool-use agents. To facilitate future research, we release the data and code.
